name: claude-code-status
description: Real-time Claude Code session stats in the VS Code status bar: token usage, context window fill, cache hits, turns, duration, and more.

commands.title: Claude Code Status: Show Session Detail
Claude Code Status: Toggle Display Mode

claudeCodeStatus.enabled.description: Enable or disable the Claude Code Status display.

claudeCodeStatus.refreshInterval.description: Refresh interval in seconds for updating stats.

claudeCodeStatus.displayMode.description: Display mode: compact (6 separate items) or detailed (verbose labels).

claudeCodeStatus.showTokens.description: Show token usage / context window fill.

claudeCodeStatus.sessionsDir.description: Override path to Claude Code sessions directory. Leave empty for auto-detection (~/.claude/sessions/).

claudeCodeStatus.projectsDir.description: Override path to Claude Code projects directory. Leave empty for auto-detection (~/.claude/projects/).

claudeCodeStatus.settingsFile.description: Override path to Claude Code settings.json (used to read the configured model, following claude-switch). Leave empty for auto-detection (~/.claude/settings.json).
